name: DLMM KING Pools
description: DLMM KING is a DLMM (Dynamic Liquidity Market Maker) liquidity layer and decentralized exchange built for capital-efficient onchain trading. It enables liquidity providers to deploy and actively manage concentrated liquidity strategies, while dynamic fees and bin-based liquidity provide efficient execution for traders across multiple chains.
methodology: We count the token balances in in different liquidity book contracts

name: Arcus pTokens
description: Arcus pTokens are transferable ERC-20 vault shares representing proportional exposure to managed Arcus perpetual accounts with predefined markets, directions and leverage
methodology: TVL is the net asset value of all production Arcus pToken managed perpetual accounts registered by the pToken factory, read on-chain from totalAssets() on each ERC-4626 vault and denominated in USDG. Test vaults are excluded. It is marked doublecounted because pToken collateral is transferred to the Arcus Perps bridge and is already included in Arcus Perps TVL.

name: Statics Protocol
description: Statics is an onchain launch protocol on Robinhood Chain with a permanent STATICS/WETH market and reserve-backed Statics Operators.
methodology: TVL is the WETH side of the permanent canonical STATICS/WETH Uniswap v4 market plus the native ETH reserve backing circulating Statics Operators. The STATICS side of the market and STATICS Operator backing are excluded as protocol-owned token value. The pool liquidity is also counted by the Uniswap v4 adapter.

name: Nullmask
description: Nullmask is a zero-knowledge privacy protocol on Ethereum. Users shield ETH and USDT into a shielded pool, transact and swap privately inside it, and unshield to any address. Deposits are AML-screened before they enter the pool.

name: GIGA V2
description: GIGA V2 is a decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: token.select
description: A custom launchpad on Robinhood Chain that aligns community and creator incentives. Contributors fund a launch at a fixed price, the launch migrates into Uniswap V3 pools with contributors earning a pro-rata share of the fees for life.
methodology: TVL is the WETH side of the Uniswap V3 positions held by token.select lpVaults. Launched tokens are enumerated from the factory's NewTokenSelectToken events and each token's lpVault is read on-chain, so vaults added later are included automatically. Only the WETH side is counted in TVL; the launched-token side is excluded. Staking is the $SELECT side of the same vault positions: every launch is also paired against $SELECT (address read from the factory's selectToken()), and $SELECT's own WETH pools are held there too.

name: Hybra V3
description: Hybra Concentrated-Liquidity (CL) pools use Uniswap V3 contracts without modification

name: StonkBrokers Smart LP
description: Automated concentrated-liquidity vaults that deploy assets into Uniswap V3 positions and manage and compound LP liquidity
methodology: TVL is the Smart LP (Volatility Farming) vaults on Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum One: every vault the registry has ever listed, each owning one Uniswap V3 position NFT (both legs counted) plus idle balances held between compounds. The STONKBROKER leg of the vaults is excluded from TVL and counted under staking.

name: United Founders Group
description: Two onchain treasuries back the $UFG token. Treasury v1 holds ETH from creator fees, and treasury v2 holds sfrxETH. A holder burns $UFG to redeem a share of both. Treasury v2 also lends sfrxETH against $UFG collateral.
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by UFG treasury v1 and the sfrxETH held by UFG treasury v2 on Robinhood Chain. Holders of $UFG can burn the token to redeem a pro-rata share of both treasuries. Borrowed is the sfrxETH principal that treasury v2 has lent against $UFG collateral.

name: Goo Exchange CLMM
description: Goo Exchange is a permissionless DEX for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain, built on a Uniswap V3 fork. Anyone can create a pool for any pair
methodology: Counts the tokens held by every pool created by the goo exchange factory on Robinhood Chain, found from its PoolCreated events.

name: Stryke CLAMM
description: Stryke is a maximum liquidity and minimal exposure options protocol
methodology: Value of Stryke liquidity positions across supported chains. Current Robinhood and Arbitrum markets count the AMM positions owned by their handlers, plus assets held by registered option markets. The underlying LP assets overlap with their AMM listings.

name: Frontier
description: Bonding-curve token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Tokens trade on a shared bonding curve until it fills, then graduate to a Uniswap V4 pool
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by un-graduated Frontier bonding-curve tokens on Robinhood Chain (v1 and v1.2 factories, enumerated from CoinDeployed; each token custodies what its curve raises until it fills and seeds its Uniswap V4 pool), plus the ETH leg of the permanently locked Uniswap V4 seed positions held by the Harvester (v1.2; the coin leg is the launched token itself and is not counted). Launched tokens are not counted anywhere, including the coins staked in Frontier's vaults, since their ETH backing is already counted here.

name: Tacit
description: Tacit is a family of immutable privacy pools. Shield ETH, then pay, swap and withdraw privately, on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain
methodology: TVL is the assets held by Tacit's contracts: the ETH, USDC, USDT and wstETH wrapped into the ConfidentialPool on Ethereum, the ETH shielded in the TacitEvmPool on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, and the wstETH escrowed in the CollateralEngine that backs Bitcoin locks. Balances are read from the contracts; Tacit's own token (TAC) is not counted.

name: StockRip
description: Draw a random tokenized stock position from an onchain pool. Every listing carries the ETH backing its depositor committed, and that backing is the standing bid a winner can take instead of the shares.
methodology: ETH held by the StockRip core contract, plus the tokenized equities backing every basket it custodies. Ownership is checked per token id, so a basket only counts while the core actually holds it. Each basket keeps its stock in an ERC-6551 account, so the underlying is read from that account as a real balance, with assets taken from the basket's own manifest rather than a fixed list. Baskets held by users, the RIP token and the VRF operating reserves are excluded.

name: Arrowfarm
description: Arrowfarm is a concentrated liquidity manager on Robinhood Chain that auto-compounds and rebalances Uniswap v3 and Velodrome Slipstream positions.
methodology: TVL sums each ArrowVaultConcLiq vault's token0/token1 balances() on Robinhood Chain, with vaults discovered from the vault factory's ProxyCreated logs so new vaults are picked up automatically. The ARROWFARM-USDG vault is reported under pool2 instead of base TVL, per convention for a protocol's own-token pools.

name: YieldFlow Yield Farming
description: YieldFlow is a decentralized platform for yieldfarming through staking, lending and liquidity mining.

name: The Moats
description: The Moats are a novel staking protocol designed to help protocol projects, and tokens configure an easy-to-use governance and reward distribution system
methodology: TVL counts the total value of staking tokens deposited and locked across all Moats

name: What The Hook
description: A Uniswap v4 hook that captures the price gap a swap opens between connected pools and returns the realised arbitrage to the trader and the pool's LPs instead of an outside searcher
methodology: Counts the liquidity held in every Uniswap v4 pool that runs the WTH hook. Pools are discovered from the hook's own PoolRegistered event, so pools opened later by third parties are picked up without a code change. Because v4 keeps every pool inside one PoolManager singleton, each pool's reserves are reconstructed from its state read via the v4 StateView contract's getSlot0, getTickBitmap and getTickInfo. WTH, the protocol's own token, is reported under staking; every other token is TVL.

name: Umbra Privacy V2
description: Umbra is a privacy layer on Solana. Users shield assets into per-token pools and withdraw them to a different address, breaking the on-chain link between deposit and withdrawal.
methodology: TVL is the sum of the token balances held by the Umbra V2 shielded pools, read directly from chain state. On Solana, V2 custodies every SPL token deposit in token accounts owned by a single vault authority, and native SOL deposits as the lamport balance of a single program-owned vault. On Robinhood Chain, a single pool contract holds every allowed asset, with ETH held natively. Nothing is borrowed, lent or rehypothecated by Umbra itself, and Umbra's own token is counted under staking where users have deposited it into the pool.

name: SLVR
description: A 1-minute on-chain grid lottery on Robinhood Chain. Players wager ETH on a 5x5 grid; each round a winning square is drawn with verifiable drand randomness, paying ETH prizes, an accumulating jackpot, and SLVR emissions. SLVR can be vote-escrow locked for a share of protocol fees, and LP-staked for ETH rewards.
methodology: TVL sums the native ETH held on behalf of users by the SLVR game contracts (live round pots and carry pools plus unclaimed winner emissions, the accumulating jackpot, pending veNFT staker rewards, auto-commit deposits, locked winnings and undistributed growth-fund revenue) and by the liSLVR liquid-locker contracts (undistributed vault income, liSLVR staking rewards and pooled mining deposits). Staking counts SLVR held in withdrawable vote-escrow locks, by game contracts (pending claims/emissions) and liSLVR vault deposits pending lock. Pool2 counts SLVR/WETH LP staked in SlvrLiquidityStaking.

name: Ripe Protocol
description: Ripe is a lending protocol where your entire portfolio — crypto, yield-bearing positions, tokenized stocks, NFTs — can back a single loan. You borrow GREEN stablecoin against your combined assets at weighted terms based on each asset's risk. Built to handle both crypto and the coming wave of tokenized real-world assets
methodology: TVL is third-party collateral deposited in Ripe's vaults. Collateral the protocol itself treats as unproductive is excluded dynamically: any asset whose on-chain PriceDesk mark is zero and whose LTV is zero (it cannot be borrowed against and backs no GREEN debt) does not count. Underscore vault shares held as collateral are unwrapped to their ERC-4626 underlying. GREEN, sGREEN and the GREEN legs of the protocol's Curve pools (including stability-pool deposits) are excluded as protocol-minted, following the Liquity treatment; only the external USDC/USDG legs count. Staking is RIPE held in the governance vault at market marks — note RIPE and GREEN are priced from pools Ripe itself predominantly owns. Pool2 unwraps RIPE-paired LPs to constituent reserves. Borrowed is outstanding GREEN debt from the Ledger at $1 face value.

name: Umbrae
description: Umbrae is a DeFi trading platform on Base offering DLMM discrete-bin concentrated liquidity and DAMM dynamic-fee constant-product liquidity pools.
methodology: TVL is the sum of both pair tokens held by every liquidity pool Umbrae has deployed on Base and Robinhood Chain. Pools are enumerated on chain from the pair factories via allPairsLength()/allPairs(): on Base, the original DLMM factory (paused for trading but still holding withdrawable LP funds), the current DLMM v2 factory and the DAMM v4 factory; on Robinhood Chain, the DLMM v2 factory. Each pool contributes its own balance of tokenX and tokenY. DLMM is a Liquidity Book style discrete-bin concentrated-liquidity AMM and DAMM is a dynamic-fee constant-product AMM; in both, the pair contract custodies liquidity directly, so no LP unwrapping is required.

name: Sentry
description: Sentry is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: one-click ERC-20 launches with a Uniswap V3 pool seeded at launch and the LP position permanently locked in the factory. LP fees split 65/35 between the token creator and the protocol treasury.
methodology: TVL is the base-asset liquidity held in the pools created by the Sentry Launch Factory, across both live generations, on Robinhood Chain and Ink. v3 launches hold liquidity in a Uniswap V3 pool contract whose LP NFT is permanently locked in the factory, so the WETH balance of each pool is counted directly. v4 launches have no per-pool contract: funds sit in the Uniswap V4 PoolManager singleton and the position is owned by the factory or by the immutable SentryLPVault, so each position's base-asset reserve is derived from its liquidity, tick range and the pool's current price. Both WETH-paired and tokenized-stock-paired launches are included. The launched token's own side of the pair is excluded, since its only market is the pool being measured.

name: Titan Locker
description: Titan Locker is a non-custodial token and liquidity locker on Robinhood Chain. Teams lock ERC-20 tokens, Uniswap V2 LP and V3/V4 positions, or create vesting schedules, each in its own audited contract that anyone can verify on chain.
methodology: Counts the assets held by every Titan Locker lock contract on Robinhood Chain. Each lock is its own contract created by a Titan Locker manager; lock records are read on chain to find each lock contract and its asset. ERC-20 and Uniswap V2 LP balances are read with balanceOf (LP tokens are unwrapped into their underlying tokens), and each lock's recorded Uniswap V3 or V4 position is valued from its liquidity while the lock still owns it. Only the ETH, WETH, USDG and USDe side is counted; locked project tokens and the project-token legs of LP positions are excluded. Withdrawn locks hold nothing and stop counting automatically.

name: Ouro DEX V3
description: Ouro DEX is OuroLayer's exchange on Robinhood Chain, with Uniswap V2-style pairs (V2) and concentrated-liquidity pools (V3).
methodology: Value of the tokens held in the Ouro DEX V3 pools on Robinhood Chain, discovered from factory PoolCreated events. Position NFTs staked in the Ouro farms are not added again.

name: TickerSpring Vaults
description: TickerSpring Vaults provides managed USDG liquidity to Stock Token markets on Robinhood Chain, with trading fees shared between depositors and the protocol.
methodology: TVL is the tokens held for depositors by the TickerSpring vaults on Robinhood Chain: the vaults listed by https://api.tickerspring.com/v1/merged/vaults (one per pool on Uniswap V3, Uniswap V4, Up or Ramses) and the V7 vaults their holders are moving from. Each vault counts its USDG, Stock Token or other pool token, and reward token balances net of protocol fee reserves, plus the liquidity of its pool position valued at the pool's current tick. Uncollected LP fees are excluded. The positions sit in Uniswap, Up and Ramses pools, so this TVL is also counted by those DEX adapters.

name: basedbid
description: A permissionless multi-chain launchpad with bonding curves, Flash Tokens, and white-label Boards. Boards let anyone run a branded launchpad and earn from every launch under their name. Fee routing is programmable via the Fee Builder, split to holders, buybacks, liquidity, or any wallet.
methodology: TVL includes (1) balances of the native coin, core assets and every quote token used by a listed project at the based.bid contract (EVM) or treasury/lock accounts (Solana), (2) active bonding-curve collateral on Solana, and (3) the quote-token side of LP positions (tokens launched on based.bid are excluded): Uniswap V3, Uniswap V4, PancakeSwap V3, and PancakeSwap Infinity CL positions held by the based.bid LP lock contracts (permanent lockers registered on the based.bid contract per position manager) on EVM, plus Meteora DAMM v2 and Raydium CLMM positions controlled by based.bid lock PDAs (Solana).

name: TRUSS LP
description: Automated concentrated-liquidity vaults on Aerodrome (Base). Users own their vault and pick the pool; TRUSS LP manages the range, rebalancing and emissions.
methodology: TVL is the value of everything held by TRUSS LP customer vaults: idle tokens in each vault plus the underlying tokens of every concentrated-liquidity position the vault owns (Aerodrome, UP33, Raphael, Ramses, GIGA, Fables and Hybra pools).

name: Napier
description: A modular yield tokenization protocol that enables you to own, manage, create any yield products without permissions.
methodology: TVL is calculated on-chain by querying target token balances held in Principal Token vaults and AMM pools across all deployed markets.

name: Abyss DEX
description: A permissionless concentrated-liquidity DEX with standard and quote-denominated swap-fee pool profiles.
methodology: TVL is the sum of both underlying ERC20 balances held by Abyss pools on Robinhood. Pools are discovered from factory PoolCreated events. Separate treasury and fee-vault holdings are excluded.

name: Sherwood
description: Sherwood is a privacy mixer + shielded DEX on Robinhood chain.
methodology: TVL is the balance of every asset (native ETH, USDG and any token registered through a shielded swap) held by the Sherwood vault on Robinhood chain. The asset list is discovered from the vault's TokenRegistered events.

name: Raphael Exchange CL
description: Raphael Finance is the ve(3,3) DEX for Robinhood Chain. Swap and provide liquidity on tokenized equities and native assets, with emissions and fees directed by vote-escrowed $RAPH.

name: HedgeHood Stock Yield
description: Weekly covered-call vaults on Robinhood Chain stock tokens: depositors' stock backs one call a week, and the premium is paid to them in USDG
methodology: TVL counts what depositors own in each Stock Yield vault. v1 vaults are read from managedBalances(): the stock token (active, queued for the next epoch, and redeemed but not yet claimed) plus earned premiums not yet claimed, in USDG. v2 funds, discovered from the v2.0 and v2.1 VaultRegistries on Robinhood Chain and the v2.1 VaultRegistry on BNB Chain, count the stock token and the stablecoin (USDG on Robinhood Chain, USDT on BNB Chain) each fund holds. Staking counts HEDGE staked in the HEDGE staking contract.

name: Flock Credit
description: Flock Credit lets users borrow USDG against escrowed veNFT collateral while the collateral continues voting and earning rewards that can repay debt, pay lenders, and route protocol revenue.
methodology: TVL is comprised of USDG deposited to the lending vaults and UP/LUTE/FABLES locked in veNFT collateral escrows. Borrowed USDG is reported separately and not counted towards TVL.

name: HASHCATS
description: A fully on-chain proof-of-work NFT collection on Robinhood Chain. A cat exists only when someone's machine finds a hash below the target — no allowlist, no auction, no team allocation. Every mint pays rent to all the cats already alive, and 70% of what the protocol earns buys back and burns $HASH.
methodology: Rent accrued to the cats currently alive and not claimed yet, held as ether by the HASHCATS collection at 0xca75df55cc9c476db27a7375d1fc8e794cf80721. A cat is minted only when a miner submits a hash below the collection's target, and the price is split on the spot between the cats already alive and the protocol's hook. The hook's cut leaves in the same transaction that creates it, so what stays behind is owed to NFT holders: the contract has no owner withdrawal, sweep or rescue, and the only two paths that send ether are the hook's cut at mint time and the claim paying a cat's owner. The hook's own buyback queue and Uniswap V4 position are protocol-owned liquidity and are deliberately not counted.

name: EZMoney
description: EZMoney helps users create and manage individual automated liquidity positions without needing to choose pools, set ranges, collect fees, or rebalance manually. Powered by EZManager, it keeps each position's history, performance, and real P&L easy to track.
methodology: TVL is the sum of token amounts in active EZManager CLCore concentrated-liquidity positions whose CLCore position owner is the EZWrapper (EZMoney) contract, across Base, Arbitrum, BSC, Hyperliquid, and Robinhood.

name: Fynd AMM
description: Fynd AMM is a pool extension that plugs into any type of AMM. For every trade, its proprietary mechanism scans competing liquidity venues and sets the pool's fee right below the best competing pool. That way, the pool wins the order flow, and its LPs maximise their fees
methodology: TVL is the value of the liquidity deposited in Fynd AMM pools. Fynd AMM pools are Ekubo v3 pools that use the Fynd SignedExclusiveSwap extension. The adapter finds these pools from Ekubo Core PoolInitialized events, collects the position ticks from PositionUpdated events, reads the current liquidity at each tick from Ekubo Core storage, and converts it to token amounts at the current pool price. Three test pools that are not listed in the Fynd app are excluded. Uncollected fees are not counted.

name: Coinbarrel
description: Coinbarrel is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Quote-asset side (ETH, WETH, USDG) of the Uniswap V4 launch positions permanently held by Coinbarrel's ownerless custody contract, enumerated on-chain from PositionManager Transfer events into the custody and re-verified with ownerOf, plus the WETH side of legacy Uniswap V3 launch positions held by the V3 custody. Launched tokens are excluded to avoid circular pricing. Marked doublecounted because these positions already sit inside Uniswap V4 and Uniswap V3 TVL on Robinhood Chain.
hallmarks: Hook V5 generation live (unified launcher on Uniswap V4)

name: EARN
description: Yield vaults for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Deposit stock tokens and USDG into automated concentrated-liquidity strategies that earn swap fees.
methodology: TVL is token balances in EARN Liquid Arc vaults on Robinhood Chain, read on-chain via getTotalAmounts(). Vault list comes from Steer getSmartPools (uniswap + sushi), filtered to Liquid Arc. Doublecounted vs Uniswap/Sushi DEX TVL.

name: Flock Manager
description: Flock Manager is Ravenhood's auto-compounding gauge LP vault layer plus a Tarot-core lending market that takes those vault shares as collateral
methodology: TVL is the LP staked by the Flock Manager auto-compounding vaults, unwrapped into its underlying tokens, plus the idle underlying held by each Flock Lend borrowable. UPDEX (up-v2) vaults are read from each vault's gauge balance and GigaDex vaults from Giga's ClassicChef userInfo. Vault LP paired with RVH, the protocol's token, is reported as pool2. Collateral contracts are not counted because they hold only vault shares, a wrapper around LP already counted. The LP is also counted by the DEX listings, so the protocol is marked as double counted. Borrowed is the outstanding debt of each borrowable and is reported separately, not included in TVL.

name: Borro
description: Lend stock tokens on Robinhood Chain and get paid rent by whoever borrows them, or short a stock in one step. Borro curates isolated Morpho Blue markets and Morpho Vault V2s for twelve stocks and USDG.
methodology: Counts the isolated Morpho Blue markets Borro creates and curates on Robinhood Chain: a stock-loan market and a USDG market per stock, plus the same pair for Goldstein Group's gAIX fund token. For each market, TVL is the loan assets still held by Morpho for that market (supplied minus borrowed) plus the borrower collateral posted against it; outstanding debt is reported separately under borrowed. Collateral that is itself a Borro vault share (bNVDA and the rest, posted on the USDG markets) is not added, because the stock behind it is already counted in the stock-loan market. What Borro's Morpho Vault V2s hold outside these markets (idle, or parked in another Morpho vault through an adapter) is added as the vault's asset; what they supply into the markets is counted once, in the markets. Marked double counted because Morpho Blue reports the same markets.

name: Delta
description: Delta is a liquidity infrastructure protocol on Robinhood Chain enabling users to create concentrated-liquidity ladders on Uniswap v3 and v4, staking vaults, and fee routing
methodology: TVL counts assets custodied by Delta contracts on Robinhood Chain: Uniswap v3 and v4 position NFTs held by Delta vaults and the ladder managers (unwrapped to underlying token amounts; v4 positions enumerated from the managers' open events since the chain has no v4 subgraph, then filtered to those still custodied), liquidity-depth budgets (WETH and paired tokens) held by the liquidity routers, and Uniswap v2 LP tokens staked in legacy Delta farms (unwrapped to underlying reserves). Vault share tokens and farm receipt tokens are excluded to avoid double counting. User-custodied positions are not counted.

name: ARMSys
description: Oracle-free LVR protection for Uniswap v4 LPs using volatility detection and Aave V3 yield routing
methodology: TVL is the liquidity in ARMSys pools, which are hooks on the Uniswap V4 PoolManager. On Base it is read through the Uniswap v4 subgraph. On Robinhood Chain — three tokenized-equity pools, NVDA/USDG, INTC/USDG and SPCX/USDG — there is no v4 subgraph, so each pool is read on-chain: LP positions minted on the canonical v4 PositionManager are converted to underlying token amounts using the pool's current sqrtPriceX96 and standard concentrated-liquidity math.

name: Raphael Exchange AMM
description: Raphael Finance is the ve(3,3) DEX for Robinhood Chain. Swap and provide liquidity on tokenized equities and native assets, with emissions and fees directed by vote-escrowed $RAPH.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Synthra V3
description: Synthra is the chain-abstracted trading layer: spot, liquidity and perpetual markets with CEX-like UX and on-chain settlement.
methodology: Counts both sides of every pool created by the Synthra V3 and V3.1 factories.

name: Orvex
description: Orvex is the liquidity coordination layer for Robinhood Chain's RWA economy an RWA-native MetaDEX with curated markets spanning USDG, stablecoins, tokenized equities, ETFs, and other real-world assets.
methodology: TVL is the value of tokens locked in Orvex v2 liquidity pairs (Solidly-fork PairFactoryUpgradeable) plus tokens held in the Orvex v4 concentrated liquidity Vault.

name: Zona
description: Zona is an RWA-focused lending platform that unlocks onchain utility and capital efficiency for RWAs. Zona's looping feature will allow investors to leverage up on RWAs and amplify yields with a single click
methodology: Counts the tokens locked in the contracts to be used as collateral to borrow or to earn yield. Borrowed coins are not counted towards the TVL, so only the coins actually locked in the contracts are counted. There's multiple reasons behind this but one of the main ones is to avoid inflating the TVL through cycled lending.

name: PARE
description: Yield splitting for Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens. A stock token is split into a principal token (the stock at a discount, redeems 1:1 at maturity) and a yield token (every dividend until maturity). Both trade on Uniswap v3; the principal token is collateral on Morpho Blue
methodology: Stock Tokens deposited in PARE StripVaults on Robinhood Chain, and yield-bearing dollars (sUSDx) deposited in PARE YieldVaults on Ethereum. Each vault holds what backs one series of principal (pToken) and yield (yToken) tokens until maturity.

name: Hookers
description: The incubator for hooked markets
methodology: TVL is the liquidity Hookers locks in the Uniswap V4 PoolManager across every token it has deployed. Each launch seeds one position owned by LiquidityCustody, which contains no path that decreases liquidity or moves it, so the ETH buyers pay in accumulates there permanently and only fees can leave. Launches are discovered from the factory's TokenLaunched logs, the tick range comes from the owning custody, the position's liquidity is read from Uniswap V4 StateView, and the reserves are derived from that liquidity, the tick range and the pool's current price. Every launch style is included. Both sides of each position are counted, so a launched token contributes only when it has a price of its own.

name: Skate AMM
description: The Skate AMM is Skate's flagship product that enables a shared liquidity pool across different blockchain ecosystems, agnostic of their underlying VM environments, creating a unified pricing curve.
methodology: Assets deployed on periphery chains. For EVM chains, we track the token balances in the pools. For SVM chains, we track the token balances owned by the pool addresses.

name: AlfaClub V2
description: Social finance platform where creators operate rooms with tradable room keys, launch room tokens, and distribute trading fees among creators, keyholders, and the protocol.
methodology: USDG held by the AlfaClub V2 RoomKey contract on Robinhood Chain: bonding-curve reserves backing outstanding room keys, plus key-trading fees not yet claimed.

name: Bush
description: Bush, a Balancer v3 fork on Robinhood Chain. Tracks volume, fees, revenue and supply-side revenue.

name: STOCKMON
description: STOCKMON — stock-DNA creature NFTs whose token IDs own exact onchain Vault subledgers on Robinhood Chain
methodology: TVL is the value of stock tokens, holder-backed WETH and ETH held in the two STOCKMON Genesis vaults, excluding WETH claimable by the protocol treasury. Staking is the DNA (the protocol token, which replaced MON) held in the Aetheryn vaults and the Breeding Egg escrow, which backs each Aetheryn and each sealed Egg.

name: Orchard
description: Orchard is a 5x5 plot game on Robinhood Chain. Players plant ETH on a plot; the ETH is swapped to AAPL (Apple stock token) in the same transaction. Each 75-second round one plot blooms and the players who planted there split the harvest from the other 24 plots, minus a 10% rake that funds SEED stakers, the Golden Apple jackpot and the treasury.
methodology: TVL is the AAPL held by the two Orchard game contracts (v1 and v2) - the pot of rounds not yet revealed, the Golden Apple jackpot, every harvest share still unclaimed and, on v2, player balances and the juice reserved for v1 players bridging over - plus the ETH v2 holds for the open round and player deposits until the round is sealed and swapped to AAPL, plus the AAPL already flushed to the SeedStaking contract as staker rewards. Fees accrued to the treasury and to the admin are protocol-owned and are subtracted. Staking is the SEED staked in SeedStaking.

name: Spiral Stake
description: Spiral Stake opens one-transaction leveraged ("looping") positions on Morpho Blue markets — flash-borrow the loan asset, swap to collateral, supply, and borrow against it — with each position held in its own proxy.
methodology: Spiral Stake opens leveraged positions on Morpho Blue markets. Each position is held by a dedicated UserProxy contract that supplies collateral to and borrows from a Morpho market. TVL counts the collateral held across all open Spiral positions minus the debt owed to Morpho, i.e. only the user margin, since the leveraged portion is flash-borrowed and immediately repaid out of the Morpho borrow. Debt is reported separately as borrowed. The collateral is also counted in Morpho Blue TVL, so this listing is flagged as doublecounted.

name: KeelLabs
description: KeelLabs is a non-custodial automated liquidity manager. A VaultFactory deploys one EIP-1167 clone vault per user position, and each vault holds a single concentrated liquidity position (Uniswap V3, PancakeSwap V3, PRJX or Aerodrome Slipstream) that a restricted keeper keeps in range. The keeper can only rebalance; it can never withdraw user capital.
methodology: Enumerates every vault created by KeelLabs' VaultFactory on each chain, then sums the vault's idle token0/token1 balances (including the DCA reserve and the keeper gas budget, both owner-withdrawable) plus the underlying token0/token1 amounts of its open concentrated-liquidity position — Uniswap V3 on Arbitrum/Robinhood/Ethereum, PancakeSwap V3 on BNB, PRJX on HyperEVM, and Aerodrome Slipstream on Base. All values are read on-chain; no external APIs.

name: Deepstate
description: Deepstate is a permissionless onchain central-limit order book DEX with radix-tree matching and optional top-of-book maker rewards.
methodology: TVL is the value of USDG, NVDA, and DEEP held by the Deepstate router as collateral for resting orders or as matched proceeds awaiting maker claims.

name: Boardwalk
description: Boardwalk is a permissionless, community-centered fee-protection protocol for launching, discovering, and participating in token economies.
methodology: Counts WETH contributed to active presales (held by each launch's PresaleManager), plus the WETH side of the Uniswap v2 LP staked in each launch's LPStaking contract and the permanently-locked seed LP burned to the dead address at graduation. Only the WETH side of each pair is counted; the launch-token side is self-priced and excluded. Staked BWLK on Ethereum is counted under staking.

name: SwapHood V3
description: SwapHood V3 is a liquidity protocol implemented in a system of non-upgradeable smart contracts on the RobinHood blockchain.

name: Crossbow Finance
description: Autonomous concentrated-liquidity vaults that manage LP ranges, harvest rewards, compound returns, and rotate liquidity across venues on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Vaults are enumerated from the ManifoldFactoryRH VaultDeployed event. Each vault reports its open positions; up. concentrated-liquidity positions are valued from the position manager by token id, and Uniswap v4 hook positions are resolved through the per-family lens into a pool key and tick range, with the vault's liquidity read as its ERC-6909 balance on the hook, which already includes staked shares. Idle balances held by the vaults are added for every token their own positions reference, plus the chain's settlement assets. Doublecounted against the underlying DEXs.

name: Catnip
description: Catnip is a Uniswap V2-style DEX (Alley), farms (MasterProwl), and xNIP vault (Cache) on Robinhood Chain
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: GlazeCorp Launchpad
description: GlazeCorp is a fund launchpad. Each fund token is backed by a fund that uses mining revenue to buy assets through auctions, and holders can redeem their tokens for a share of those assets.
methodology: TVL counts the assets held by each GlazeCorp fund (redeemable by fund coin holders), USDG waiting to buy assets in each fund's revenue router, Resonance stream and strategy auctions, bribe rewards held for signalers, and unclaimed mining payouts held by each Mine. Fund coins and fund pool liquidity are excluded; pool liquidity sits in Uniswap v4 and is counted there.

name: Peeps
description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain with bonding curves that graduate to locked Uniswap V3 liquidity
methodology: Peeps TVL is ETH locked in active bonding curves plus WETH in locked Uniswap V3 LP positions held by the Peeps LP fee vault on Robinhood Chain. Launch tokens are not counted.

name: Mog
description: Oracle-priced perpetual DEX for leveraged long and short positions where the protocol treasury acts as the counterparty and uses realized trader losses to fund future payouts.
methodology: TVL is the USDG held by the MogCore contract: trader balances, trader margin in escrow, and the venue treasury. Fees already paid out to the operator and buyback wallets but not yet withdrawn are excluded. MOG tokens are not counted.

name: Topaz AMM
description: ve(3,3) on BNB Chain — where protocols compete for real liquidity and veTOPAZ holders capture the value.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Hookr
description: Hookr lets users create Uniswap v4 pools with custom rules and issue tokens backed by fee income.
methodology: Counts the quote-asset side (ETH, USDG and other Robinhood core assets) of the liquidity in Hookr Uniswap V4 pools across the legacy launchpads, modular kernels and current roots, including third-party LP positions. Hookr-launched tokens are excluded. HOOKR held in these pools is counted under staking. Accrued fees, pre-pool curves and auctions, tokenizer backing and treasury or burn-jar balances are excluded. Pools overlap Uniswap V4 TVL.

name: Quantum Pools
description: Non-custodial concentrated-liquidity manager for Uniswap V3 and PancakeSwap vaults on Robinhood Chain and Base. Snuggle auto-rebalances positions into range, with per-position LP bookkeeping
methodology: TVL is the value of every Uniswap V3 and PancakeSwap V3 concentrated-liquidity position held by the QuantumPools V2/V2.1 vaults, unwrapped to underlying token amounts at the current pool tick.

name: FrothSwap
description: FrothSwap is a special purpose DEX for memecoins attached to the Froth launchpad, built on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Peridot
description: Peridot Finance is a cross-chain lending protocol that utilizes a Hub & Spoke architecture to provide unified liquidity across BSC, Monad, Somnia, and several Ethereum L2s.
methodology: TVL is the underlying held by the protocol and not lent out: on BSC, Monad and Robinhood Chain the underlying balance of every Peridot market listed on the comptroller, on Stellar the available liquidity of each cash market (USDC, XLM, PYUSD, EURC). Outstanding debt is reported separately as borrowed.

name: MerryForge
description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Fair launches, fixed supply, bonding curves, creator bonds & locked liquidity.
methodology: MerryForge TVL is raise-asset inventory in bonding curves, USDG in CreatorBondVault, and locked UniV2 LP (LiquidityLocker) from graduated launches. Excludes launch-token inventory, secondary pools, and fee revenue (FeeVault + protocolTreasury, tracked separately as treasury).

name: Vimen
description: Vimen, a fully-backed index basket protocol on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the value of the tokenized stocks and chain-native tokens held as 1:1 backing by every live basket token, plus any USDG rebalance buffer a basket holds. Baskets are enumerated on-chain from the three immutable factories (allBaskets) together with the five first-party baskets deployed before the factories existed; each basket reports its own constituent list on-chain and balances are read from the basket contract itself. User wallets and undistributed dividend pots held by payout distributors are not counted.

name: Goo Exchange Vaults
description: Liquidity vaults that generate yield from arbitrage trades, automatically compounding profits for depositors
methodology: Counts what the holders of every Goo Exchange curated vault own: each vault's two Uniswap V3 positions at its pool's price, plus what the pool owes the vault and its idle tokens, less what payees are owed. Vaults are listed by the vault factory. Their pools sit on a separate factory from the Goo Exchange DEX, so this TVL is not part of the DEX's.

name: Priors
description: Unsecured USDG credit lines for ERC-8004 AI agents on Robinhood Chain. Backers stake behind each line, and every repayment builds the agent's public on-chain record.
methodology: TVL is the USDG held by the Priors credit pool (v2, and lenders still in the paused v1), the USDG invite bonds, and the stock tokens deposited as collateral in the StockVault. Backers' stakes are pool shares inside the pool's USDG, so they are not added again. Borrowed is the principal of the open loans (totalPrincipalOut). Staking is the $PRIORS escrowed in the seat vaults behind agents' lines.

name: RaiseHood
description: Fair-raise token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: fixed-price presales paired with ETH, USDG, or Robinhood stock tokens. Settlement auto-seeds V3 liquidity that is time-locked in the protocol's fee vault, and buyers get mutually exclusive claim-or-refund outcomes
methodology: Quote assets (ETH, USDG, tokenized stocks) escrowed in RaiseHood sale contracts during active raises, plus the locked V3 LP positions auto-seeded at settlement. Locked LP sits in Uniswap V3 / RobinSwap pools tracked separately, so doublecounted.

name: Morpheus
description: Morpheus is a concentrated-liquidity decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain
methodology: Counts tokens locked in Algebra Integral concentrated liquidity pools created by the Morpheus factory on Robinhood Chain and BSC.

name: TickerSpring Baskets
description: Themed baskets of Stock Tokens and crypto tokens on Robinhood Chain. Each basket is a Balancer V3 weighted pool you buy or sell as one token.
methodology: TVL is the tokens held by the TickerSpring Balancer V3 vault on Robinhood Chain for its baskets: weighted pools of Stock Tokens, crypto tokens and USDG or WETH. SPRING, the TickerSpring token, is excluded.

name: Alandale V2
description: Alandale is a ve(3,3) DEX on Robinhood Chain. LPs earn LUTE emissions, veLUTE lockers vote weekly on emissions and receive all trading fees and bribes.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Pez Family
description: Pez Family is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain with bonding curves and Uniswap V4 graduation pools.
methodology: TVL is the quote asset (native ETH and approved pair tokens) held by active Pez bonding curves on Robinhood Chain. Curves are enumerated from the factory TokenLaunched events and excluded after their PoolGraduated event, when the reserve moves into a Uniswap V4 pool.

name: GlueHook
description: GlueHook is a general-purpose Uniswap V4 hook — not platform-specific. Any project attaches it to its own pool permissionlessly and gets: a buyback pot (a per-pool treasury anyone can fill), pump (the pot buys on buys), shield (the pot absorbs sells at the pool's exact output), a burn cascade (token burn() → 0xdEaD → held forever with a public counter), and a self-compounding LP with configurable fee splits. It is not upgradeable, has no owner or admin keys, and takes zero protocol fee — 100% of what flows through it belongs to each pool's own program
methodology: TVL = the liquidity of every hook-owned LP program position inside the Uniswap V4 PoolManager (valued from the program liquidity at the pool's live price) + every token held by the GlueHook contracts themselves (per-pool buyback pots, parked donations, pending fee splits, permanently-held unburnable tokens). Pools are enumerated from PotInitialized events on the canonical V3 hook and on the superseded V1/V2 hooks whose pools still hold funds. Live metrics: https://dune.com/lalilulel0x0869/gluehook-live

name: Sheriff V3
description: CLMM on Robinhood Chain.

name: Twofold
description: Twofold runs DualPool pools on Robinhood Chain: Uniswap v4 hook pools pairing tokenized stocks and ETH against USDG, where the USDG side also earns yield in Steakhouse vaults. TWO holders stake for USDG and TWO streams
methodology: TVL is the two-sided reserves of every Twofold DualPool pool, read from the hook (getReserves) for each pool listed in either Twofold Registry (the 2026-09 stack and the 2026-08 stack, both live), plus the permanently locked TWO/WETH genesis position in Uniswap v4. Staking is totalStaked TWO in the two staking vaults (StakingVaultV2 and TwoStakingUSDG) plus the TWO held by the vTWO governance wrapper; undistributed reward balances are excluded. Marked doublecounted because the hook keeps its reserves as ERC-6909 claims in the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and as deposits in the Steakhouse USDG vaults (Morpho), and the genesis position sits in a Uniswap v4 pool, all of which are counted by those listings.

name: Flowlex
description: Flowlex is a non-custodial app for earning Uniswap V3 fees: deposit USDC, pick a strategy, and Flowlex opens and manages the concentrated-liquidity position from your own smart wallet.
methodology: Counts the Uniswap V3 positions opened through Flowlex, valued at the pool's current price, plus each position's uncollected fees. Positions are the NFTs minted by the Flowlex LP manager (found by its PositionOpened and PositionRebalanced events); they sit in the users' own smart wallets, and other Uniswap positions in those wallets are not counted. Closed and burned positions are excluded. Double counted with Uniswap V3.

name: Fake Wall Street
description: Fake Wall Street is a lootbox style game on Robinhood chain where users open packs to win a random tokenised stock from the pool
methodology: Value of the Tokenized Stocks on the Pool

name: Paboxo
description: Lending market for Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain: deposit USDG to earn, or borrow USDG against Stock Tokens and WETH.
methodology: TVL is the USDG held by the Paboxo earn vault and by the lending markets it supplies, plus the stock tokens and WETH that borrowers hold as collateral in their Position contracts (found through PositionCreated events), plus the tokens inside the Uniswap v3/v4 LP NFTs held as collateral by the LP market Positions. Borrowed is the outstanding USDG debt of every market.

name: SwapHood V2
description: SwapHood V2 is a liquidity protocol implemented in a system of non-upgradeable smart contracts on the RobinHood blockchain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Hybra V2
description: Public liquidity layer on Hyperliquid · Upgraded ve(3,3) flywheel · CL & intent-based gasless trades
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Unihood
description: UNIHOOD is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain where every token trades in a Uniswap V4 pool from launch. The factory places the full 1B supply as single-sided liquidity with no withdrawal path, and a global hook routes the 1% swap fee on the ETH side (80% creator / 5% bid wall / 15% platform)
methodology: TVL is the ETH buyers have deposited into UNIHOOD launch pools (each pool holds its full token supply as locked single-sided liquidity, so the ETH side is computed from the pool tick and the fixed liquidity constant) plus ETH fee claims held by the UNIHOOD hook on the PoolManager, which fund the bid walls and unclaimed creator fees. Launched tokens themselves are not counted.

name: PerpsHood
description: Perpshood — launchpad on Robinhood Chain where every coin's trading fees fund a real leveraged perp position backing it.
methodology: TVL is the quote-asset reserves (native ETH or approved pair tokens such as tokenized stocks) held by the Pons v2 bonding curve of every live perpshood-launched coin; balances are read on-chain. The curve list comes from perpshood.fun/api/llama.json because the launch factory is shared infrastructure and perpshood launches are not distinguishable on-chain. Graduated coins (liquidity in Uniswap V4) are excluded, as is the leveraged perp margin backing each coin, which sits on the Lighter venue.

name: AEON Protocol
description: AEON Protocol is a ve(3,3) DEX on Avalanche C-Chain (chainId 43114) with a unified factory that manages all pool types (vAMM, CL, DLMM).
methodology: Counts tokens held directly by AEON Protocol pool contracts on Robinhood Chain across its three pool types: constant-product (vAMM) pools (enumerated from both the original and current AeonFactoryRH factories, plus a fixed set of pools migrated outside the factory, listed explicitly), Algebra Integral concentrated-liquidity (CL) pools, and Trader Joe/LFJ Liquidity Book (DLMM) pools enumerated from their factory.

name: HoodSale
description: Presale launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Projects create a token and run a presale in a few clicks; the contracts collect the contributions, add the liquidity, lock or burn the LP and deliver the tokens.
methodology: ETH escrowed in HoodSale presale contracts while a sale is running (contributions are held by the sale until it launches or refunds), plus the liquidity locked by finished sales: V2 LP held in the HoodSale LiquidityLocker by sales that chose to lock instead of burning it, and the Uniswap v4 launch position of v4 sales, held for good by the HoodSale hook, the v4 position locker or the dead address. Only the ETH side of the locked liquidity is counted. Lockers are read from the factory and from the sales themselves, so a locker replaced through setLocker stays counted. Locked liquidity also sits in the DEX pools tracked separately, so it is marked as double counted. Platform revenue held by the Treasury is not counted.

name: Story.fun
description: AI-powered Narrative Launchpad. We turn stories into scripts and characters into assets.
methodology: Counts the quote asset (native ETH) held by every live Story.fun bonding curve, the reserves a sold-out curve has handed to the LaunchFactory while its pool is being created, and the quote side of the full-range Uniswap V4 positions permanently locked in the LiquidityLocker after graduation. Launch tokens are not counted: on a curve they are unsold supply, and in a graduated pool they are priced by that same pool.

name: RobinSwap V3
description: RobinSwap V3 is a decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain.

name: EscapeHub Launchpad
description: Token launchpad on Solana, Base and Robinhood Chain. Tokens trade on a bonding curve and graduate to EscapeSwap on Solana and Uniswap v4 on Base and Robinhood
methodology: Counts SOL and ETH in bonding curves that have not graduated yet. Solana: SOL balance of the vault of every non-graduated bonding curve. Base and Robinhood: ETH balance of every market created by the TokenFactory. Graduated liquidity and launched tokens are not counted.

name: Sheriff V2
description: AMM on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: ParitySwap V2
description: ParitySwap is a Uniswap V2 + V3 fork DEX on Robinhood Chain for swapping ETH, USDG, and Robinhood Chain tokens
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Gage
description: Gage is a fixed-term peer-to-peer lending protocol on Robinhood Chain. Borrowers lock tokenized stocks, crypto assets or liquidity positions for USDG, then repay a fixed amount to reclaim collateral or allow the lender to claim it after expiry and grace. Loans have no price-triggered liquidation.
methodology: Counts user collateral in custody across every Gage lending contract (listed at docs.gage.cash/protocol/addresses, partner lending at docs.gage.cash/protocol/bounty-targets): the legacy deal vaults (ERC-20 collateral, including collateral awaiting withdrawal, and USDG escrowed for open bids) and the V2 engines, Intent cores included (collateral held by each loan account, whatever the loan state, and lender funds committed to loans that have not activated). Earn strategies and Intent partner vaults (every vault each Intent factory has created) add their idle cash, repayments they have received but not yet booked, their reserve position and what side pockets hold for depositors who have not claimed yet. Intent lend-asset generations lend a stock token instead of USDG: their amounts are counted in that token. USDG credited for withdrawal (loan proceeds, repayments, withdrawn bids, protocol fees) and fees owed to vault managers or the protocol are excluded. Vault-owned Uniswap V3/V4 NFTs are unwrapped into underlying principal without uncollected fees. Gross active loan principal is reported separately under borrowed until repayment, claim or a finalised default. Excludes GAGE, sGAGE, the internal receipt tokens, reward reserves, the treasury and the protocol-owned GAGE/sGAGE pool. Token balances are priced by DefiLlama.

name: Catch Exchange
description: A protocol for fixed-supply cAsset markets whose holders have pro-rata redemption claims on separate underlying-asset reserves funded by trading fees and paid releases.
methodology: TVL is the value of external underlying assets held in Catch family reserve vaults and redeemable by active cAsset holders. Uniswap V4 liquidity, unreleased cAsset inventory, fee-routing balances, and the CATCH-backed cCATCH family are excluded.

name: keep.coffee
description: keep.coffee is a refundable token launchpad on Solana and Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the refundable stablecoin held in keep.coffee's per-launch vaults/contracts, plus the USDG side of RH Full's full-range Uniswap V4 launch positions. It covers active raises, post-bootstrap refund reserves, cancelled-raise balances and failed-raise refund pools; the launched-token side of each pool is excluded because it is minted by Keep and has no independent collateral value. The RH V4 liquidity is also counted by the underlying Uniswap V4 listing.

name: Gloam
description: Privacy protocol enabling shielded balances, private payments, and payroll using zero-knowledge proofs
methodology: TVL is the tokens held by the Gloam shielded pool on Robinhood Chain, Tempo, Base, Ethereum, Elysium and BNB Chain. On Robinhood Chain, Base and Ethereum the accepted assets are discovered from the pool's DepositLimitSet events. $GLOAM held in the pool is the protocol's own token and is counted under staking.

name: LiquidCore
description: The first pAMM on Hyperliquid utilizing read precompiles
methodology: Total value of all coins held in the LiquidCore pool contracts.

name: Synthra Launchpad
description: Synthra is the chain-abstracted trading layer: spot, liquidity and perpetual markets with CEX-like UX and on-chain settlement.
methodology: Counts the real quote-asset reserves (WETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc) backing active Synthra Launch bonding curves. Virtual curve reserves and fee pots are excluded. At graduation the curve reserve is removed and the resulting pool liquidity is counted by Synthra V3, preventing double counting.

name: Puzzle Ranges
description: Puzzle Ranges is a concentrated-liquidity DEX built on a fork of the Balancer V3 stack. Its Range Pools are weighted pools that trade against virtual balances rather than their real token balances, which concentrates the whole of a pool's liquidity into a chosen price range and gives LPs leverage on the fees earned inside it.
methodology: TVL is the sum of the actual token balances (balancesRaw) the Ranges Vault holds for every pool listed by the RangePoolFactory, read with vault.getPoolTokenInfo. BPTs of range pools held by other range pools are excluded so that the underlying assets of a nested pool are not counted twice.

name: SushiSwap V4
description: SushiSwap V4: A Uniswap V4 fork
methodology: Sum of pool currencies held in the SushiSwap V4 Vault, discovered from CLPoolManager Initialize events.

name: LUNA
description: On-chain gamified mining. Every 60 seconds, miners deploy ETH across a 25-square grid. A drand beacon, verified on-chain, selects the winning square; the miners on it split the round pot and mint LUNA. LUNA can be staked for a share of protocol revenue paid in ETH.
methodology: TVL counts the ETH held by the two game contracts: LunaGame (active round deposits, unclaimed ETH winnings, the Motherlode jackpot) and EclipseGame (the current prize pot and unclaimed dividends), plus ETH in the staking contract. Staking counts LUNA locked in timed staking positions and in the game contracts.

name: TETRAVAULT
description: TETRA is backed by a redeemable reserve of tokenised stocks (SPY), gold (GLD), oil (USO), ETH and USDG on Robinhood Chain. 4% of every trade goes into the reserve; holders can redeem their share of the basket at any time, stake for 6-hourly emissions paid only from real backing growth, or bond at a discount. No owner, no admin keys, protocol-owned liquidity.
methodology: TVL is the SPY, GLD, USO, WETH and USDG held by the TETRAVAULT Reserve contract on Robinhood Chain, funded by bond purchases and the 4% trade tax, and redeemable pro rata by burning TETRA. Borrowed is the USDG the Reserve has lent against escrowed TETRA. Staked TETRA is not counted, since its backing is the Reserve already counted in TVL.

name: RobinFun
description: Launch ideas. Trade narratives. A launchpad for market-born tokens.

name: RH.fun
description: RH.fun is a bonding-curve token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Anyone can launch a token in seconds; tokens graduate to Uniswap V2 once the curve target is reached. Supports ETH and USDG markets
methodology: Counts collateral held by RH.fun market contracts on Robinhood Chain, enumerated from factory events: ETH/USDG in un-graduated bonding-curve clones (NewRHTokenCurveParams), quote-token tax accrued on per-token TaxProcessor and Dividend clones (NewRHTaxTokenParams), and native balances of market vaults (MarketVaultCreated). When a curve graduates, its liquidity migrates to the chain's Uniswap V2 DEX and the curve is drained to zero in the same transaction, so graduated liquidity is no longer counted here. Locked allocations of launched tokens themselves are excluded.

name: Bonker
description: Creator-first token launchpad on Base with locked liquidity, Uniswap v4 hooks, launch-time MEV protection, and on-chain creator rewards.
methodology: Counts the paired-currency side of Uniswap V4 liquidity positions created by the Bonker factory and permanently held by a Bonker LP locker. Positions are enumerated on-chain from TokenRewardAdded events, and launchpad-minted tokens are excluded to avoid circular pricing. A chain can have more than one locker across its history since setLocker() only adds, never replaces, so every locker that has ever been live on a chain is summed.

name: Orixium
description: Orixium powers CaveWatch, a gamified on-chain mining protocol on Robinhood Chain. Users participate in ETH-funded Hunts, mine OIX, compete for ETH reward pools and progressive jackpots, and commit OIX to Vault positions that participate in protocol ETH revenue distributions.
methodology: TVL counts native ETH held in CaveWatch Hunt, Motherlode, Lucky Vein and Auto Hunt contracts. Recoverable OIX locked in the OIX Vault and permanently sacrificed OIX that remains economically committed to the Vault and continues receiving Vault reward weight are reported as staking. Sacrificed OIX is non-withdrawable and represents a permanent Vault position. OIX release inventory, treasury balances, Vault reward ETH and game-held OIX are excluded.

name: HOLI Pre-Genesis Farm
description: Pre-Genesis Farm where users deposit supported assets to accumulate an allocation for the HOLI Genesis launch
methodology: TVL is the value of ERC-20 assets deposited into Holi Pre-Genesis Farm on Robinhood Chain. SHYT deposits are counted under staking.

name: Fang
description: Algorithmically pegged to USDG, powered by a dual-token model and backed by a diversified crypto and tokenized equities on Robinhood.
methodology: Pool2 deposits consist of FANG/USDG and GFANG/USDG LP tokens deposits while the staking TVL consists of the GFANGs tokens locked within the Masonry contract(0x33Be17082Bd477dC804EdabBa1A8D777Da3F668d).

name: Hoodbets
description: HoodBets is a parimutuel betting pool on real stock prices, running on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by the HoodBets contract: open parimutuel betting pools plus settled winnings awaiting claim. Markets are settled permissionlessly against Chainlink stock price feeds.

name: Aeva Bridge
description: The Aeva bridge moves $AEVA and USDG between Robinhood Chain and Aeva Mainnet over Hyperlane
methodology: TVL counts the USDG locked in the Aeva bridge's Hyperlane collateral router on Robinhood Chain, which backs aeUSD on Aeva Mainnet. $AEVA locked in the AEVA router is Aeva's own token and is counted under staking.

name: StonkBrokers Desks
description: Anvil 2 way desks (InternExchange), permissionless NFT desks (bids / asks / both on a price ladder) for any ERC-721 collection
methodology: TVL is the quote token liquidity staked on every Anvil 2 way desk (InternExchange) on Robinhood Chain and Ethereum: each desk is enumerated from the exchange registry and its idle quote balance (ETH, WETH, USDG, stock tokens on Robinhood; ETH, WBTC, USDT, USDC, APE, XAUt on Ethereum) is counted. NFTs listed on the ask ladders are not priced. STONKBROKER quoted desks are tracked under staking.

name: Quiver Protocol
description: AI-managed concentrated-liquidity vaults on Robinhood Chain — autocompounding Uniswap V3 and V4 LP strategies, including tokenized-stock pairs (NVDA, AAPL, GOOGL, SPCX). Non-custodial, Beefy-style price-blind shares; withdrawals are always permissionless and in-kind
methodology: TVL is each Quiver vault's concentrated-liquidity position (liquidity between the strategy's tick bounds valued at the current pool tick) on Uniswap V3 and V4 pools on Robinhood Chain, plus idle token balances held by the strategies between compounds.

name: Stax
description: Tokenized-stock index baskets on Robinhood Chain: mint a basket token backed 1:1 by its underlying stock tokens, redeem anytime.
methodology: TVL is the tokenized-stock tokens and USDG held as basket collateral by the Stax vaults and community-basket contracts on Robinhood Chain, read from each basket's on-chain composition and priced individually. Staked STAX and undistributed rewards are excluded.

name: HoodMint
description: HoodMint is a memecoin launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Tokens launch on a pump.fun-style bonding curve; on graduation the raised ETH moves into a permanently locked Uniswap V3 position
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by the HoodMintCurve singleton: the real ETH reserves backing every open bonding curve, plus trade fees accrued but not yet claimed by creators/protocol. Liquidity of graduated tokens sits in permanently locked Uniswap V3 positions and is counted under Uniswap V3, not here, to avoid double counting.

name: DexLaunch
description: DexLaunch is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain: fixed-price presales that auto-list their raise as locked DEX liquidity, pump.fun-style bonding curves that graduate to Uniswap V3, and instant single-sided V3 launches
methodology: TVL is the native asset held by live bonding curves (ProtocolLens.getPadEthTvl), wrapped-native locked in the shared TokenLocker (LP unwrapped to underlyings; locked graduation LP included; V3 positions priced by id), and each active presale's funding-asset balance. Same lens-driven sources on every deployed chain.

name: Astro
description: Astro is a provably fair crash game that settles in USDG. Users can either play or deposit and hold ASTROLP shares to take the House side
methodology: Counts the USDG held by the Astro BankrollVault on Robinhood Chain: the liquidity provided by LPs to the bankroll (ERC-4626 ASTROLP), the players' withdrawable balances, and the stakes wagered in the round currently in play.

name: HedgeHood Options
description: Cash-settled European options on tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain, settled in USDG and traded by AI agents over RFQ and on the HedgeHood options desk
methodology: TVL is the USDG held by the seven option markets (one per underlying stock): account deposits, the margin that backs short option positions and premiums not yet withdrawn. Options are cash-settled in USDG, so the markets hold no stock.

name: BowStop
description: BowStop is a gamified mining game on Robinhood Chain where players commit ETH to a 25-target grid each 1-minute volley; resolved volleys mint BOW rewards, distribute a Sheriff's Purse jackpot, and permanently lock a share of BOW into veBOW positions for protocol-yield stakers.

name: ArrowPad.fun
description: ArrowPad.fun is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain
methodology: TVL is the WETH side of the permanently locked Uniswap V3 LP positions held by the ArrowPadLocker.

name: ROAR
description: ROAR is the internet's magic roaring money. Fair-launched on the Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL counts only user-owned WETH liabilities: active-round escrow and unclaimed settlement rewards in the Game, plus prepaid automated-mining escrow in the canonical AutoMiner. Pending admin settlement, Treasury assets, and Giga LP liquidity are excluded. Staking counts the Game reward liability (unclaimed round rewards and the Motherlode) plus all ROAR held by the Staking contract as staked principal, earned rewards, and unvested rewards.

name: HedgeHood Share Lending
description: A HedgeHood-curated Morpho vault lending USDG against Stock Yield fund shares, allowing borrowers to retain their covered-call fund exposure while accessing liquidity on Robinhood Chain
methodology: Counts USDG deposited in the HedgeHood-curated Morpho Vault V2 (hhUSDG), including assets lent against Stock Yield fund shares. Uses the standard curator accounting and is marked doublecounted because the vault supplies Morpho Blue. Pledged fund shares and their underlying assets are excluded.

name: yld.cx
description: Liquidity rental markets. Provide or rent tokens at your price
methodology: User-owned ERC-20 assets held by Yield Orders v0.3 and v0.4, read from on-chain tokenLiability per pair token. v0.3 liability includes accrued protocol fees, which are subtracted; in v0.4 fees and donations sit above liability and are excluded by construction.

name: Kiltr
description: Kiltr — Balancer-style AMM (v2 + v3 Vaults) on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the sum of every pool token held by the Kiltr v2 and v3 Vaults (Balancer-style single-Vault architecture). Pool tokens (BPT/KPT) held by the Vaults are excluded.

name: heks.fun
description: heks, a coin launchpad on Robinhood Chain
methodology: TVL is the liquidity heks locks in the Uniswap V4 PoolManager across every coin it has launched. Each launch seeds one one-sided position that can never be withdrawn — held by the launchpad vault in earlier deployments, and from V2.2 minted through the Uniswap V4 PositionManager with its NFT sent to the dead address — so the pair asset buyers pay in accumulates there and only fees can leave. Launches are read from the launchpads' TokenCreated logs, which carry both currencies and the position's tick range (V2.2 launches also name their NFT in LaunchTermsV22); the position's liquidity is read from Uniswap V4 StateView, and the reserves are derived from that liquidity, the tick range and the pool's current price. Both sides of each position are counted, so a launched coin contributes only once it has a price of its own. Liquidity that other users add to these pools (possible from V2.3 once a launch's opening windows are over) is theirs and is not counted.

name: Phera DEX
description: PheraDEX is a concentrated-liquidity (CLMM) DEX and token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in PheraDEX concentrated liquidity pools.

name: 0Swap
description: A zero-fee decentralized exchange and Uniswap fork on Robinhood Chain where users trade directly against on-chain liquidity pools.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Solon Stocks
description: Platform issuing stock tokens on Arc backed 1:1 by corresponding native stock tokens held in a reserve vault on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the Robinhood Chain stock tokens (NVDA, AAPL, TSLA) held by the Solon ReserveVault, which backs the .sol stock tokens minted on Arc 1:1. The .sol tokens on Arc are not counted.

name: DARKPOOL
description: Private swaps on Solana and Robinhood Chain. Users shield coins into a private balance and swap through Jupiter (Solana) or Uniswap (Robinhood Chain); a relayer signs, so the wallet isn't on the trade
methodology: Coins shielded into the DARKPOOL private pool: every reserve token account of the pool state on Solana, and ETH, WETH and USDG held by the pool contract on Robinhood Chain. Shielded $DARKPOOL, the protocol's own token, is counted under staking.

name: ALPHA Launchpad
description: One launchpad on six chains. Launch a token with one wallet signature and pair it with any listed coin, stablecoin, stock token or gold
methodology: TVL is the pairing asset held by each ALPHA bonding-curve market. Markets are read from the factory Launched events on EVM chains and from the program Market accounts on Solana, and counted at the pairing asset balance they hold, which includes fees waiting to be settled. Graduated liquidity sits in Uniswap v4 or Meteora DAMM v2 and is not counted here.

name: STEEL
description: STEEL is an on-chain grid-mining lottery + veSTEEL staking protocol on Robinhood Chain. Each round, players deploy ETH onto a 5x5 grid; a provably-fair drand beacon picks the winning square, whose backers split the round's ETH pot and mine a fixed STEEL emission. A 1-in-625 roll triggers a motherlode (STEEL + ETH). STEEL can be locked into veSTEEL to earn a pro-rata share of protocol ETH revenue.
methodology: tvl = native ETH held by the mine (auto-deploy escrow, pending winnings, motherlode). staking = STEEL locked in the veSTEEL staking contract

name: Ilyris
description: Discrete-bin AMM on Robinhood Chain. Pools are the swap entry point (pull-based, no router).
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: kicker
description: Redeemable reserve vaults on Robinhood Chain. Each vault holds a single core asset (ETH, GLD or NVDA tokenized stock); vault shares redeem pro rata for that asset and NAV per share is non-decreasing.
methodology: TVL is the core asset (native ETH or a tokenized stock such as GLD/NVDA) held by Kicker pots. Pots are enumerated from the Created events of every factory version. A pot may also hold coins created through it; those are the protocol's own tokens and are not counted.

name: BTB Finance
description: BTB Finance auto-rebalances concentrated liquidity positions. Each user gets their own smart wallet; an agent keeps their positions in range and staked, and only the owner can withdraw
methodology: Sums the concentrated liquidity positions (held or staked in a gauge or farm) and tokens held by every BTB Finance auto-rebalance smart wallet. Wallets are found from the BTB factories' AccountCreated events; each user owns their own wallet and nothing is pooled.

name: PFWA Markets
description: Prediction markets on Robinhood Chain where every outcome is its own bonding-curve token. Markets cover token prices and market caps (any coin on CoinGecko), onchain metrics from DefiLlama, and football (Premier League and Champions League)
methodology: Lists every market from both PFWAMarketFactory contracts (marketCount, getOptionTokenAddresses) and counts the native ETH held by each outcome token contract (open positions and unclaimed winnings), plus the ETH each factory holds for the markets' bonus pots. Only ETH is counted; the outcome tokens themselves and the $PFWA token are not.

name: Peddles
description: A launchpad where every token launches into a locked Uniswap v4 pool, paired to ETH or to a tokenised stock.
methodology: Counts the liquidity in every pool created by a Peddles launch: Uniswap v4 pools, and on Anubis Gully Core (a PancakeSwap Infinity fork) CL pools. Pools are read from the Peddles fee hook's PoolRegistered events, each pool's key from its Initialize log, and reserves are rebuilt on chain from tick liquidity and the current price (via StateView on v4, from the CLPoolManager on Gully). Launch liquidity is locked in these pools. Fees the hook has accrued but not yet paid out are not counted.

name: bskts
description: Index baskets of Stock Tokens and crypto on Robinhood Chain. Each basket is one token backed 1:1 by its holdings in an on-chain vault, bought and sold at net asset value, and always redeemable for the holdings
methodology: TVL is the tokens held by every bskts basket vault on Robinhood Chain: the Stock Tokens and crypto behind each basket token, read from the vault itself. Baskets are listed on-chain by the bskts factory, and each basket reports its own constituents. The Beefy CLM vault shares held by the yield baskets are excluded, as Beefy already counts them. The BSKTS index holds other baskets' shares, already counted, so only its USDG is added. Tokens in users' own wallets and bskts accounts, open orders, and the Weekend Cover market are not counted.

name: MinePea
description: PEA is a gamified mining protocol on Robinhood Chain. Players compete in continuous 60-second rounds, deploying ETH across a 25-tile pentagon to earn ETH and PEA tokens. Competitive gaming mechanics layered with DeFi infrastructure
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by the GridMining contract (ETH deployed to active rounds plus unclaimed ETH winnings). Staking counts PEA locked in the Staking contract plus unclaimed mined PEA held by GridMining.

name: RobinSwap V2
description: RobinSwap V2 is a decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Chance
description: Chance is a launchpad for prize games on Robinhood Chain. Anyone can launch a prize game: fund a prize in USDG or a listed token, set the entry price, and players buy entries to win. Every entry is settled onchain with Pyth Entropy randomness and payouts are sent automatically by the contracts.
methodology: Counts prize deposits and unsettled entry payments escrowed in the Chance InstantWin and MultiWin game contracts (current and previous deployments) on Robinhood Chain. CHANCE, the protocol's own token, posted as prizes is counted under staking.

name: DOTT
description: DOTT (Dump on the Trenches), a memecoin launchpad + self-custodial trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Counts the ETH held in DOTT (DumpFactory) bonding curves on Robinhood Chain that have not yet graduated. Curve addresses come from the factory's Launched events and their native ETH balances are summed. Graduated tokens migrate liquidity to a Uniswap V3 pool (counted by Uniswap), so only pre-graduation curve reserves are counted here to avoid double-counting.

name: STELX
description: A shielded pool on Robinhood Chain. Hold, send and swap USDG, ETH and tokenized stocks privately.
methodology: TVL is the balance of every supported token held by the STELX shielded pool on Robinhood Chain (WETH, USDG and tokenized stocks). STELX held by the STELX token pool is counted under staking.

name: Phera DEX Launchpad
description: PheraDEX is a concentrated-liquidity (CLMM) DEX and token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Quote-asset deposits held by every live PheraDEX bonding curve, net of the graduation liquidity reserve the curve retains from trading fees. Unsold launch-token inventory minted by the curve itself is excluded, as are curves that have graduated into PheraDEX CL pools.

name: Hood Index
description: hMAG7 is a fully-backed on-chain index of the seven MAG7 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, TSLA). Shares mint and redeem in-kind against the IndexVault; NAV is priced via Chainlink feeds. No leverage, no rehypothecation.
methodology: TVL is the value of the seven Robinhood Chain stock tokens (MAG7: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, TSLA) held as collateral in the hMAG7 IndexVault. The index is fully backed and mints/redeems in-kind; NAV is priced via Chainlink feeds. There is no leverage and no rehypothecation.

name: Mixpad
description: Mixpad, a Uniswap V4 hook-based token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the quote-token (WETH/USDG) liquidity locked in every Mixpad token pool on Robinhood Chain. Each token launches its full supply as a single one-sided Uniswap V4 position (LP burned). Reserves are reconstructed on-chain from the position liquidity and current price via Uniswap V4 StateView.

name: HOODZ
description: 4-player arena bomb brawler on Robinhood Chain. Players enter rounds with $HOODZ tokens; winners are paid ETH automatically from the on-chain prize pool.
methodology: TVL is the ETH prize pool held by the HOODZ game contract on Robinhood Chain, awaiting automatic distribution to round winners. Players enter rounds with $HOODZ tokens; winners are paid in ETH directly from this contract.

name: VS Trade
description: VS Trade is a relative performance market protocol that allows users to bet on which stock will outperform the other.
methodology: TVL is the USDG collateral held by every VSMarket contract created by the VS factory (minus protocol fees accrued but not yet swept to the treasury). Each market holds 1 USDG for every outstanding complete set of outcome shares, plus the AMM pool liquidity.

name: NLYRA
description: AI trading and security terminal on Robinhood Chain: token scanner with risk levels, on-chain trading bots, OTC desk, prediction rounds and real-yield staking.
methodology: TVL counts the ETH, WETH, USDG and USDe that users keep in the NLYRA Desk escrow contracts (grid, infinity, DCA, TWAP, martingale, ladder, copy-trading and sniper bots, the OTC desk and open Predict rounds). NLYRA held in the escrows is not counted. Staking counts the NLYRA held by Staking v1 and Real Yield Staking v2.

name: Parabolarc
description: Fair-launch token engine on Arc. Each launch is a USDC Uniswap v4 pool with locked liquidity. Collected pool fees fund a USDC floor, holder rebates, Labs, a $PARC buyback, and the creator
methodology: TVL is the quote-asset side of each Parabolarc Uniswap v4 launch pool, including the locked launch position and the floor. On Arc that quote is USDC. On Robinhood it is native ETH for the one-pair and multi factories, and for the stock factories it is whichever token each launch is paired against (a Robinhood stock token or another ERC20), including earlier factories that still have live launches. The launched tokens are excluded, since their only market is the pool Parabolarc seeded. Extra multi-quote pools besides the ETH/USDC market, fee treasuries, and the $PARC buyback vault are excluded. Marked doublecounted because the pools sit in the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and are already inside Uniswap v4's TVL on that chain.

name: HedgeHood StockLend
description: Isolated stock-lending markets on Robinhood Chain. Lenders deposit a stock token; a borrower posts collateral, borrows the stock for a fixed term and pays an opening fee and a time fee in the collateral token
methodology: TVL counts what each StockLend market holds: the stock lenders deposited that is not lent out, and the collateral borrowers posted (USDG; SGOV or SPY on two retired markets). Borrowed counts the stock out on loan (lentOut).

name: Turret
description: Lending on Robinhood Chain, with USDG loans against tokenized collateral and fixed-term peer-to-peer token and NFT loans.
methodology: Counts available lending cash (excluding accrued protocol fees), ERC-20 collateral held by credit engines, and cash/collateral in P2P escrow including unwithdrawn settlement credits. Includes legacy custody without counting pool receipt tokens. Outstanding loans are reported under borrowed. TURRET staking is excluded. Treasury wallets, reward reserves and NFT collateral valuations are excluded.

name: HoodPump
description: HoodPump is a community token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Every launch creates a token/WETH Uniswap V3 pool and permanently locks its liquidity position.
methodology: TVL is the WETH side of the Uniswap V3 liquidity positions locked in the HoodPump Liquidity Locker. Each HoodPump launch locks its LP NFT in the locker; only the WETH across those positions is counted (HoodPump-launched tokens are excluded). Liquidity lives in Uniswap V3 pools, so this is flagged doublecounted.

name: Waddle Club
description: Waddle Club lets any project fund liquidity mining rewards for its own Uniswap V3 pool. Pick the reward token, amount and window, fund it in one transaction, and LPs stake their position NFT to earn
