methodology: tvl is the assets the Waddle Club stakers custody: the staked Uniswap V3 style LP NFTs unwrapped to their underlying tokens at the pool's current tick, plus reward tokens funded into incentives and not yet claimed or refunded (discovered from IncentiveCreated events). LP value is also counted by the underlying DEX, so tvl is double counted at the chain level.

name: Architect Swap V3
description: Uniswap V2 and V3 based DEX of the NLYRA ecosystem on Robinhood Chain. Tokens launched on the NLYRA launchpad trade here.
methodology: Value of the tokens held in the Architect Swap V3 pools on Robinhood Chain, discovered from factory PoolCreated events.

name: Yieldfy
description: An ERC-4626 yield optimizer that automatically routes deposited assets to the highest-scoring yield venue using deterministic onchain rules.
methodology: TVL is the sum of totalAssets() across the Yieldfy ERC-4626 USDG vaults on Robinhood Chain. This counts USDG sitting idle in a vault plus USDG the optimizer has routed into an external venue (Morpho, Steakhouse), which a raw balance check would miss. Marked doublecounted because deployed USDG is also counted by those underlying venues.

name: Architect Swap V2
description: Uniswap V2 and V3 based DEX of the NLYRA ecosystem on Robinhood Chain. Tokens launched on the NLYRA launchpad trade here.
methodology: Value of the tokens held in the Architect Swap V2 pairs on Robinhood Chain, enumerated from the factory.

name: Oter Finance
description: The first lending protocol for Robinhood tokenized stocks. Oter is building an incentive-driven lending market for onchain stocks.
methodology: Counts the tokens locked in the contracts to be used as collateral to borrow or to earn yield. Borrowed coins are not counted towards the TVL, so only the coins actually locked in the contracts are counted. There's multiple reasons behind this but one of the main ones is to avoid inflating the TVL through cycled lending.

name: ParitySwap V3
description: ParitySwap is a Uniswap V2 + V3 fork DEX on Robinhood Chain for swapping ETH, USDG, and Robinhood Chain tokens

name: KOLSwap
description: KOLSwap is KOLMarket's non-custodial creator-token AMM on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: Hoodit
description: Hoodit is a DLMM (Liquidity Book v2.2 / Trader Joe lineage) exchange on Robinhood Chain — liquidity in discrete price bins, zero slippage within a bin, dynamic volatility fees for LPs. Permissionless pool creation, fee tiers 0.10%-5.00%.
methodology: We count the token balances in in different liquidity book contracts

name: Ellipse Bridge
description: Bring USDC to Arc.
methodology: Counts the assets held in the Ellipse CustodyVaults on their origin chains (CRCL and GLD on Robinhood Chain, USDT and BTCB on BSC), which back the 1:1 bridged tokens issued on Arc.

name: DaWabLauncher
description: DaWabLauncher is a market-lifecycle protocol on Robinhood Chain for relaunching existing ERC-20 tokens through bonding curves that graduate into AMM liquidity with permanently locked LP custody.
methodology: Counts the quote assets committed to DaWabLauncher markets on Robinhood Chain. Active bonding curves count their quoteReserve. Graduated markets count the quote-token share of the AMM liquidity represented by LP tokens held by the protocol liquidity vault. Relaunched-token inventory and protocol fees are excluded.

name: Polydash
description: Polydash is an onchain ecosystem on Robinhood Chain with the Polypad launchpad, tokenized fund vaults, and permissionless staking pools.
methodology: TVL is ETH held by Polypad launch contracts and commit vaults, plus ETH, WETH and mandate-list tokens (except POLYDASH) held by Polydash tokenized fund vaults, plus the stake-token balance of pools from the staking factories, which includes rewards a pool holds in its own stake token. Pools that stake POLYDASH are counted as staking. Reward tokens other than the stake token, virtual ETH on bonding curves, and Uniswap liquidity after graduation are excluded.

name: Credence
description: A token deployer on Robinhood Chain: every token it deploys is tied to a live Polymarket prediction. The token's trading fees fund the bet, winnings buy back and burn the token, and every harvest burns $PFWA
methodology: Cash held by Credence vaults. Robinhood Chain: the ETH, WETH and USDG in every CredenceVault (v1, v2 and the retired rehearsal factory, listed onchain by each factory's vaultCount/allVaults), i.e. trading fees waiting to be bridged to the bet or used for a buyback, and in every deployed CreatorFeeVault (fees held until the named X account claims them). Polygon: the pUSD, USDC.e and USDC in every PolyVault (v1 vaults from the v1 factory's PolyVaultCreated events, v2 vaults from PolyVaultFactoryV2.allVaults), i.e. fees waiting to buy the outcome and winnings waiting to go home. Polymarket outcome shares (CTF ERC-1155 positions) are never counted, nor are the launched meme tokens, their curve or pool liquidity, $PFWA, or launch fees held by the launcher contracts.

name: DropSwap
description: Multi-chain DEX aggregator routing swaps across 20 chains via LI.FI and Odos, with a native utility token (DROP) funded by real protocol fee activity.
methodology: Value of the tokens locked in the liquidity pools.

name: CHEQ3
description: Private programmable credit: a cheque book for onchain money. Users hold USDG in a shielded account, pay with zero-knowledge drafts, and can issue cheque books whose spending rules are enforced by the circuit. Credit comes from CHEQ3's own Compound v3 market
methodology: TVL is the USDG held by the CHEQ3 shielded pool plus the USDG and collateral (WETH, SGOV and Robinhood tokenized stocks and ETFs) held by CHEQ3's own Comet credit engine. The pool supplies its idle USDG to that engine, so those funds are counted once, in the engine. Borrowed is the engine's outstanding USDG debt.

name: Dirac Classic Curation
description: Dirac Finance builds curation infrastructure for financial strategies.
methodology: Counts assets deposited in the Morpho Vault V2 vaults curated by Dirac, discovered on-chain via the DefiLlama curators registry by their deployer/owner address (morphoVaultOwners). One of Dirac Finance's two curation modes; the other is delta-neutral DiracVault strategies (dirac-delta-neutral-curation)

name: flooor.fun
description: NFT auction platform on Base chain.
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held in the flooor.fun auction contracts on Base and Robinhood Chain (the current main contract, the legacy contract, and one auction contract per NFT collection), comprising the current highest bid locked in escrow (activebidAM) plus accumulated epoch pool rewards (poolAccrued). When sellToHighest() is called, the winning bid is split: 95% is sent to the NFT seller and 0.5% to the protocol as a fee, while 4.5% stays in the contract as epoch pool rewards (poolAccrued) until signers claim it.

name: Buttonwood Cash
description: Buttonwood Cash is a fixed-term, non-liquidating credit protocol. Borrowers buy tokenized equities with a stablecoin down payment and repay in 36 monthly payments; positions are never force-liquidated. Lenders fund the loans through origination pools and the Rollover Vault.
methodology: TVL is the tokenized-equity collateral held by each SubConsol for open mortgages (including any amount moved to a yield strategy), the stablecoins backing USDX, and assets held by the Forfeited Assets Pool from foreclosed mortgages. USDX, Consol, SubConsol and Forfeited Assets Pool tokens held by origination pools, vaults or users are claims on these same assets and are not counted.

name: Nullark
description: Nullark is a fixed-denomination shielded ETH pool on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Native ETH principal represented by unspent Nullark notes, calculated as pool native balance minus accrued protocol fees.

name: H00D
description: H00D is a Robinhood Chain token launchpad that creates fixed-supply tokens directly into Uniswap V3 and transfers each launch LP NFT to its LaunchLocker. H00D is implemented in the HoodForge repository
methodology: Every token launched through H00D seeds a Uniswap V3 pool whose LP NFT is held by the H00D LaunchLocker. The adapter enumerates those locked positions on Robinhood Chain and values only their WETH principal; launched tokens and unclaimed trading fees are ignored. The same liquidity is part of Uniswap V3 TVL, hence doublecounted.

name: Ouro DEX V2
description: Ouro DEX is OuroLayer's exchange on Robinhood Chain, with Uniswap V2-style pairs (V2) and concentrated-liquidity pools (V3).
methodology: Value of the tokens held in the Ouro DEX V2 pairs on Robinhood Chain, enumerated from the factory. LP tokens staked in the Ouro farms are not added again.

name: Stockless
description: Stockless turns trading fees into liquidity for Robinhood tokenized stocks. Every cycle a Harvest contract buys a stock and $STOCKSS and adds them as a Uniswap v4 position held by the protocol; fees from those positions are compounded, burned or shared with $STOCKSS holders
methodology: Stockless provides liquidity for Robinhood tokenized stocks with trading fees: each cycle a Harvest contract buys a stock and $STOCKSS and adds them as a Uniswap v4 position held by a LiquidityAdapter contract. TVL counts the stock side of every adapter position plus idle stock tokens held by the adapter contracts of every version; stock held by Harvest contracts is reserved for $STOCKSS holder payouts and is not counted, and the $STOCKSS side is the protocol token and is not counted.

name: Stryke RFQ
description: Stryke is a maximum liquidity and minimal exposure options protocol
methodology: Cash balances in the identified RFQ settlement escrow, option-position and funded-payout contracts. Excludes trader wallets, bridge balances, market-maker external hedges, fee treasury and notional option exposure. Staking counts SYK held by the StakedSYK contract.

name: StonkBrokers Nightshades
description: Anti-snipe token launch platform where WETH raised for faction tokens transitions into protocol-owned Uniswap V4 liquidity after bonding
methodology: TVL is the Nightshades anti-snipe launch on Robinhood Chain: the WETH raise escrowed in the anti-snipe pad before bond, the snipe-tax WETH held in the FactionLiquidityVault, and the WETH leg of each bonded faction's protocol-owned Uniswap v4 position. Faction-token legs are not counted.

name: PeddleQuest
description: PeddleQuest is a quest and loyalty platform. Projects fund a reward pool in an on-chain escrow before a quest can go live, users complete tasks, and winners claim their rewards from the escrow with a Merkle proof.
methodology: Reward pools that quest creators have deposited into the PeddlesQuestEscrow contract and that have not yet been claimed by winners or swept after the claim deadline. Counts the escrow's balance of the chain's gas token and of every allow-listed reward token. On Arc the gas token is USDC, so only the native balance is read.

name: ymym.meme
description: Hybrid launchpad with V3 single-sided LP and graduation mechanics. Instant DEX trading, no LP migration, no token taxes. Creators earn fees.
methodology: TVL is the value of WETH in the permanently locked Uniswap V3 LP positions.

name: Packed
description: Packed, a coin launchpad on Robinhood Chain and Ethereum.
methodology: TVL is the quote asset (native ETH, USDG or a tokenised stock) held by every Packed bonding curve on Robinhood Chain that has not graduated. Curves are listed from the Launched events of every Packed factory and read on chain. A graduated coin's reserve has moved into a Uniswap V4 pool, which the uniswap listing already counts, so it is left out; Packed coins on Ethereum launch straight into Uniswap V4 pools and are left out for the same reason.

name: Spine Finance
description: Spine Finance is a Fixed-Rate Origination Infrastructure, created for the institutional-grade management of digital assets. Built on Ethereum and the EVM ecosystem, Spine introduces a hybrid liquidity architecture that bridges the gap between vault-based lending and orderbook-style term structures.
methodology: TVL is the idle USDG in the Spine vault, the vault's deposits in its ERC-4626 sub-vaults (currently Steakhouse USDG on Morpho), and the collateral posted in the borrow controller. Outstanding USDG loans are reported as borrowed.

name: Gmoon
description: Gmoon is a Robinhood Chain coin launchpad that creates locked Uniswap v4 pools and converts trading fees into tokenized stocks, ETFs and crypto, which holders earn by depositing coins into the Earn Vault.
methodology: Counts assets held by the Gemoon Vault: the meme tokens staked by users, USDG swap fees pending distribution, and converted reward assets. The list of memes comes from the TokenCreated events of the controller. The Referrals contract is not counted. Liquidity in the Uniswap V4 pools of the memes is held by the PoolManager and is counted by the Uniswap V4 adapter, not here.

name: outbidfun.lol
description: A token launchpad on Robinhood Chain where coins outbid each other for the front page. Coins launch on bonding curves priced in WETH, USDG or tokenised shares, then graduate into locked Uniswap V3 liquidity
methodology: Reserve assets (WETH, USDG and other listed assets) held by every outbidfun.lol coin whose bonding curve is still live, found from the MemeCoinDeployed events of every CoinFactory registered in the protocol registry (today the first, and the one on the constant-product curve that replaced it for new launches on 28 September 2026). Graduated coins, whose reserve has moved into a locked Uniswap V3 pool, are excluded, as are the launched coins themselves.

name: BlueFun
description: Fair multichain token launchpad for Base and Robinhood Chain, offering bonding-curve and direct Uniswap v4 launches with permanently locked LP principal.
methodology: Counts native assets held in BlueFun bonding-curve markets on Base and Robinhood Chain before graduation. Assets are withdrawn from a curve as it graduates into Uniswap v4, whose pool liquidity is counted by the DEX adapter instead.

name: DoublePlus
description: Coin launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Coins launch on a bonding curve, either open or as a raise with a target that refunds if missed; when the curve fills, the coin gets a Uniswap v4 pool in the same transaction with its liquidity locked. Creators earn up to 4% of trades and holders earn dividends.
methodology: Counts the native ETH held by the DoublePlus factory, which escrows bonding-curve raises before a coin graduates (plus fees owed), and the WETH side of every Uniswap v4 pool a graduated coin was given. Pools are listed from the factory (allTokens and listings), and their reserves are rebuilt on chain from tick liquidity and the current price via StateView. Pool liquidity is owned by the factory and cannot be withdrawn. Launched coins are not counted.

name: PerpsFunds
description: Permissionless perpetual futures protocol that allows users to create leveraged markets using Uniswap v3-style pools for pricing, with ERC-20 collateral and isolated liquidity vaults acting as counterparties
methodology: Lists every perps book from PerpsHub (one per margin token) and counts each book's balance of its margin token — LP vaults and traders' margin — minus the fee shares accrued for the protocol and market creators but not yet claimed.

name: Sharewoods
description: RWA and Crypto Markets on Robinhood Chain built on Morpho Blue
methodology: Count all assets are deposited in all vaults curated by Sharewoods.

name: EL-Casino Rooms
description: EL-Casino: provably-fair on-chain casino on Robinhood Chain — every room (roulette, crash, blackjack, slots, keno, …) is its own contract with its own token pool that anyone can stake into to become the house.
methodology: Sums the tokens held by every EL-Casino room, listed from the V4, V5, V6 and V7 game factories: each room's token pool pays winnings and is funded by stakers ("become the house"). Rooms whose pool is in $ELCAS, the protocol's own token, are excluded.

name: Adexto
description: ADEXTO opens token markets as permanent bonding curves with no creator allocation on 0G, Monad, Base, Arbitrum and Robinhood Chain. Creators earn a share of every trade.
methodology: Native coin (ETH, MON or 0G) held by ADEXTO bonding curves, which are listed by each factory generation. This includes creator and protocol fees not yet claimed. The unsold market tokens the curves hold are not counted.

name: Kyros Finance
description: Kyros is built to support RWA markets alongside stablecoins and crypto supply tokenized equities, borrow against them, and manage everything from one onchain account on Robinhood Chain

name: frenlaunch
description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain and Arc. Tokens launch on a bonding curve that graduates into a Uniswap v4 pool with locked liquidity, or straight into a Doppler pool on Robinhood Chain. Creators earn trading fees for the life of the token, and referrers are paid on-chain.
methodology: Native asset (ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc) held by frenlaunch bonding curves that have not graduated. Curves are enumerated from the factory's TokenLaunched events. Graduated pools and Doppler pools are Uniswap v4 liquidity and are excluded.

name: Resu
description: Resu splits any on-chain asset into Senior/Middle/Junior tiers. Senior is protected and takes a fixed coupon; Junior takes the first loss and the highest yield. The on-chain buffered note
methodology: TVL is the net asset value locked in each Resu pool

name: PFWA Sherwood
description: A PvP arena game built into Uniswap v4 hooks on Robinhood Chain. Every buy in the game pool scores points, players steal, shield and flip, and each round's top players take the ETH pot while part of it buys back and burns the pool's token
methodology: Counts the native ETH held by the Sherwood game hooks (Season 1 on the ETH/$PFWA pool, Season 2 on the ETH/$IMD pool): round pots, unclaimed prizes and referral rewards, and the ETH reserved for buyback-and-burns. Liquidity in the Uniswap v4 pools is not counted, since it belongs to the LPs and is already part of Uniswap's TVL.

name: Zenze
description: Zenze is a token launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Anyone can launch a token on a bonding curve and trade it in the same pool.
methodology: TVL is the quote asset held by each Zenze bonding curve. The token a curve is selling is not counted. Collected fees are not counted. Curves quoted in $ZNZF, the protocol's own token, are counted as staking.

name: Lincoln Protocol
description: Lincoln Protocol — private balances on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Each Lincoln privacy pool is an immutable contract holding a single asset (ETH, USDG/USDe, a Robinhood tokenized stock, or the protocol tokens LINCOLN/SPCX). TVL is the on-chain balance of every pool. Route adapters and relays hold no user funds between transactions, so they are not counted.

name: Kyte
description: Non-custodial, fully collateralised call and put options on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the collateral locked behind open options on Robinhood Chain: the underlying tokens held by the CallMarket contracts (covered calls) and the WETH held by the PutMarket contracts (cash-secured puts). The token list is read from the on-chain AssetRegistry. Staking is the $KYTE locked in the StakingPool, which receives 30% of protocol fees.

name: PeddleSwap V2
description: PeddleSwap is a DEX on Robinhood Chain, Base, Arc and Anubis: swap, provide liquidity in V2 or concentrated V3 pools and lock tokens and LP positions, with limit orders, a token launchpad and a bridge on selected networks.
methodology: Value of reserves in PeddleSwap V2 pools on Robinhood Chain, Base, Arc and Anubis, discovered from each factory. Uses the standard core-asset reserve valuation.

name: Overcall
description: A trustless platform for skill-based markets across crypto and stocks: prediction and trading, priced by decentralized oracles and settled onchain.
methodology: TVL counts the USDG that players and channel creators hold in the USDG vault (open positions, unclaimed royalties, held wins): the vault balance less the protocol's own capital and fee revenue, which are tracked as treasury. Staking counts the $OVER staked in the staking contract, plus the players' and creators' $OVER in the $OVER vault, worked out the same way.

name: ArrowPad
description: Token launchpad on Robinhood Chain — launch a coin in seconds on a fair bonding curve; tokens auto-graduate to Uniswap.
methodology: ETH held in the ArrowPad bonding-curve contract: funds raised by launched tokens that have not yet graduated to Uniswap.

name: Gully Core
description: Gully Core is an AMM and token launchpad. One Vault holds the tokens of every pool; pools are concentrated liquidity or liquidity-book bins, with optional hook contracts. Tokens launched through Gully Core's launch kit trade on a real pool from the first block, with their launch liquidity locked permanently
methodology: Gully Core is a singleton AMM: one Vault holds the tokens of every pool. TVL is the Vault balance of every currency initialized in the CL and Bin pool managers.

name: BowYard
description: Create on Robinhood Chain, trade on a transparent bonding curve, and graduate automatically into a permanently locked BowYard DEX pool.
methodology: Counts canonical USDG held in BowYard bonding curves, user-funded Launch Agent budgets, Agent Launchpad V2 curves, and the USDG side of permanently locked BowYard DEX pools on Robinhood Chain. BowYard-launched tokens, fee and revenue vaults, and protocol treasury balances are excluded.

name: Latch Protocol
description: A Latch is a hook contract attached to a pool. Deploy your own Launchpad or DEX on Latch’s shared core in one transaction: your wallet, your fee terms, your brand
methodology: TVL is the Vault's balance of every token in a pool initialized on the CL or Bin pool manager, plus any balance held by each pool's hook contract.

name: EL Perps
description: EL Perps: permissionless perpetuals on any token with a Uniswap v3 / Ramses pool, margined in any token (one book per margin token), instant fills against per-market LP vaults, retroactive liquidation from the pool's price history.
methodology: Lists every perps book from the ElcasMarketsHub v1, V2 and V3 hubs (one per hub and margin token) and counts each book's balance of its margin token — LP vaults and traders' margin — minus the fee shares accrued for the platform and market creators but not yet claimed. Books margined in $ELCAS, the protocol's own token, are excluded.

name: DeepCore
description: DeepCore is an AMM and token launchpad. One Vault holds the tokens of every pool; pools are concentrated liquidity or liquidity-book bins, with optional hook contracts. Tokens launched through DeepCore's launch kit trade on a real pool from the first block, with their launch liquidity locked permanently.
methodology: DeepCore is a singleton AMM: one Vault custodies every token for the whole protocol, and pool managers hold nothing. TVL is the Vault's balance of every token that has appeared as currency0 or currency1 in an Initialize event from CLPoolManager or BinPoolManager, plus any balance held by the hook contract each pool was created with. Native currency appears as the zero address in a pool key and is read as the Vault's native balance.

name: RobinIndex
description: Index token backed by Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens (tokenized equities). Target weights are computed on-chain from each token's circulating supply x Chainlink price; single-asset mint/redeem with a weight-deviation rebate/penalty keeps the basket at target.
methodology: TVL is the USD value of all Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens (tokenized equities, priced via Chainlink) held in the RBDXVault contract, which backs the RBDX index token 1:1 by NAV.

name: AvaLove
description: AvaLove — a permissionless on-chain game/staking protocol on Avalanche C-Chain and Robinhood Chain
methodology: TVL is the total value of tokens staked as house liquidity across every game pool deployed through the AvaLove factories on each chain. For each per-game factory the adapter enumerates all deployed pool contracts via getGames() and sums the balance of each pool's staking token held by its game contract. Staking additionally counts protocol-level $AVLO staked in the ProtocolYield contract. Player bets and payouts flow through these same pools, so their token balances represent the protocol's live liquidity.

name: PeddleSwap V3
description: PeddleSwap is a DEX on Robinhood Chain, Base, Arc and Anubis: swap, provide liquidity in V2 or concentrated V3 pools and lock tokens and LP positions, with limit orders, a token launchpad and a bridge on selected networks.
methodology: Token balances in PeddleSwap V3 pools on Robinhood Chain, Base, Arc and Anubis, discovered from factory PoolCreated events.

name: BullGems
description: Memecoin launchpad on Robinhood Chain. Same curve for everyone, then Uniswap with locked liquidity.
methodology: ETH sitting on live BullGems curves (realQuote). The memecoin, virtual reserves, fee pots and treasury are not included.

name: Solon Earn
description: Solon is a lending interface and curator built on the Morpho protocol on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Counts leverage lending-pool underlying reserves, idle USDG/WETH and the underlying principal of Uniswap V3 LP positions held by Solon vaults on Robinhood Chain; the Morpho-curated solUSDG lending vault is tracked separately via the curators registry and is not counted again.

name: Moonvault
description: Moonvault automates yield farming to make DeFi easy, safe and efficient for all. By autocompounding your tokens, Moonvault unlocks higher returns so you earn more of what you love.

name: StonkPress
description: StonkPress is a liquidity programme for the SPY stock token on Robinhood Chain. PAPER targets 0.0001 SPY: above target the protocol prints PAPER to PLATE stakers, below target it buys PAPER back. Farms pay PAPER and oPLATE for SPY liquidity.
methodology: TVL is single-asset deposits (SPY, WETH, USDG and partner tokens) in the Genesis and reward pools. Pool2 is PAPER/SPY and PLATE/SPY LP staked in those pools, and staking is PLATE in the Masonry; PAPER and PLATE are valued through their SPY pairs.

name: RUKUS
description: A community launch network with ETH bonding-curve Instant Launch and liquidity-first community-funded Backed Launch on Robinhood Chain
methodology: Counts the ETH held by RUKUS Instant bonding curves and Backed campaign escrows, discovered from the two factories' creation events. Launched tokens and liquidity moved to Uniswap V4 after graduation or settlement are not counted.

name: Solon Borrow
description: Solon is an independent Morpho curator on Robinhood Chain. It curates USDG vaults lending against issuer-verified tokenized equities, with on-chain issuer beacon verification of collateral and depth-measured supply caps.
methodology: Counts all assets deposited in Morpho vaults curated by Solon on Robinhood Chain and Arc.

name: Metric V0
description: DEX
methodology: TVL is the sum of token0 and token1 balances held by every pool created by the Metric pool factory. Pools are discovered on-chain from the factory PoolCreated events.

name: Ravenhood Mindshare
description: Deflationary treasury protocol on Robinhood Chain. Permissionless, immutable burn engine buys back and burns RVH using treasury LP fee revenue; 95% of supply was seeded as single-sided, permanently-locked liquidity at launch
methodology: Staking is RVH deposited into RVHStakingPool.

name: Based Alpha
description: Based Alpha — pump.fun-style token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the ETH held by the Launchpad contract, which custodies every live bonding curve's reserves (plus accrued, unclaimed protocol/creator fees and any transient WETH from migrations). Liquidity that has graduated to Based DEX V3 pools is excluded and counted under the DEX.

name: Tirelire
description: Tirelire, an automated Uniswap V3 liquidity manager (ALM) on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: TVL is the value of both tokens held by each Tirelire Hypervisor across its active Uniswap V3 positions, idle balances, and uncollected fees, read on-chain via getTotalAmounts(). Tirelire deploys the audited Gamma Hypervisor verbatim; there is no custom accounting.

name: popi
description: Gacha bonding-curve memecoin launchpad; raises are escrowed on the curve until graduation, then migrated to the chain's DEX (PumpSwap on Solana, Uniswap v3 on Robinhood Chain).
methodology: popi is a bonding-curve memecoin launchpad on two chains. TVL is the quote asset escrowed in live (still-bonding, not-yet-graduated) launches. Robinhood Chain: we count the native ETH held by the shared UUPS launchpad proxy, which equals the sum of every bonding launch's escrow excluding graduated funds (migrated to Uniswap). Solana: each launch owns a System-owned vault PDA (seeds ["vault", launchPubkey]); we enumerate Launch accounts, exclude Graduated ones (migrated to PumpSwap), and sum the native SOL in the surviving vaults. Launched tokens themselves and post-graduation DEX liquidity are not counted here.

name: USDAX Finance
description: A yield-bearing, overcollateralized stablecoin on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Tracks APX tokens deposited by users in the USDAX Finance APXStaking contract on Robinhood Chain. TVL is derived as the contract's total APX balance minus the protocol-owned reward pool, capturing both actively staking positions and amounts currently in the 7-day cooldown window. Protocol reward reserves are excluded.

name: wambo.fun
description: wambo.fun is a live parimutuel betting venue on Robinhood Chain: five memecoins race for ten minutes, scored by Uniswap v3 TWAP, and backers of the winner split everyone else's stake. Settlement is fully on-chain via the RaceBook contract.
methodology: TVL is the native ETH held by the RaceBook contract: live race stakes, unclaimed winnings and refunds, accrued rake and the pot rolling into the next race.

name: LuckyLaunch
description: LuckyLaunch — a dual-chain (Avalanche + Robinhood) token launchpad with its own native x*y=k AMM DEX ("AvaLove DEX").
methodology: TVL is the AVLO locked across every LuckyLaunch pool: the AVLO raised on each Phase-A bonding-curve presale plus the AVLO reserve of each graduated Phase-B AvaLove DEX pool (x*y=k, LP permanently locked). Launchpad-minted tokens are excluded per DefiLlama convention. Pools are enumerated on-chain from each chain's LuckyFactory (launchesLength + launches).

name: NetNet Capital Management
description: OlympusDAO-v1-style reserve currency protocol on Robinhood Chain. $NET is backed by a USDG treasury (partly deployed to Morpho), protocol-owned NET/USDG liquidity, and an RWA mandate executed via an on-chain desk that routes USDG into tokenized equities (Robinhood stock tokens via Rialto) held in the NetNet RWA Sleeve. All core contracts are immutable (no owner, no pause, no upgrade).
methodology: NET staked in the NetNet staking contract

name: HoodVault by HoodMarket
description: HoodVault lets anyone bundle ERC-20 tokens (and optionally one existing NFT) into a single ERC-6551 token-bound-account vault, minted as a tradeable NFT on Robinhood Chain.
methodology: Value of tokens in all the HoodVault ERC-6551 vaults

name: NUKES.FUN
description: A reserve-backed protocol where treasury assets back the NUKE token, with bonding and rebasing staking mechanisms.
methodology: NUKE staked in the NUKES.FUN staking contract

name: BV-7X
description: BV-7X is a protocol on Robinhood Chain that turns model-generated price predictions into a staked, tradable commodity. Staking BV7X is the right to predict; agents' calls are committed on-chain before the outcome is known.
methodology: Staking counts BV7X staked in the BV-7X MultiRewards staking pool on Robinhood Chain, read as the pool's totalSupply (staked principal only; BV7X held in the pool as reward inventory is excluded). BV7X is the protocol's own token, so it is reported under staking, not TVL.

name: Unicrypt Vesting V2
description: Token vesting.
methodology: Counts ERC-20 balances of tokens held under vesting schedules in the Unicrypt Vesting V2 contracts across supported chains.

name: Orbio
description: AI inference marketplace and gateway where users can buy, sell, transfer, and activate tokenized AI inference credits.
methodology: Counts ORBIO tokens deposited in the Orbio staking contract on Robinhood Chain.

name: EL Predict
description: EL Predict: UP / DOWN price rounds on any token with a Uniswap v3 / Ramses pool, staked in any token, with a per-market house vault anyone can LP.
methodology: Lists every prediction book from the ElcasMarketsHub v1, V2 and V3 hubs (one per hub and stake token) and counts each book's balance of its stake token — house vaults, stakes in open rounds and unclaimed winnings — minus the fee shares accrued for the platform and market creators but not yet claimed. Books staked in $ELCAS, the protocol's own token, are excluded.

name: Quotum
description: Stake QUOTUM for private AI inference seats on Robinhood Chain. Trading tax funds inference usage; unspent seat allowances buy QUOTUM and burn it at the daily bell.
methodology: Staking is QUOTUM principal deposited in QuotumStaking. The protocol's own token is excluded from ordinary TVL. TaxSink funds earmarked for inference payments and buybacks are excluded from TVL.

name: Capsule
description: Capsule opens graded trading-card packs and lists the card as a 7-day USDG loan on Robinhood Chain. A funder deposits the card's buyback quote. If the owner repays, the funder receives 3% and the protocol receives 1%..
methodology: TVL is the USDG balance of the CapsuleLend contract on Robinhood Chain. That balance is principal still held by a funded loan. It drops when the owner withdraws the principal, the loan is repaid, or the loan defaults and the stablecoin leaves the contract. The Solana card vault and the Robinhood treasury wallet are not counted.

name: GongFu
description: On-chain token locking on Robinhood Chain: users lock GF for 1-180 days and get the same GF back at the end; capped rewards are paid only from a fixed, non-withdrawable reserve.
methodology: Staking counts the GF principal currently locked by users in the GongFuPool contract (principalLiability). The protocol-owned reward reserve held by the same contract is excluded.

name: BOND Capital
description: Institutional-grade, reserve-backed holdings on Robinhood Chain. Every $BOND is backed by treasury reserves with a NAV floor and algorithmic governance. Stake BOND to grow your position, or earn through the Liquidity Program
methodology: BOND staked in the BOND staking contract. Pool2 is BOND/USDG liquidity staked in LP staking.

name: Nullroot Protocol
description: Nullroot Protocol is a compliant privacy pool on Robinhood Chain. Users deposit ETH or USDG, deposits are screened against the OFAC list into an association set, and users withdraw privately to a fresh address with a zero-knowledge proof. Ragequit always lets the original depositor exit
methodology: TVL is the ETH and ERC-20 balance held by every Nullroot privacy pool registered on the Entrypoint (PoolRegistered events plus the current assetConfig pool for each asset).

name: wstO Vault
description: Deposit O for non-rebasing wstO shares, redeemable for O with no deposit or redemption fee. Trading fees from wstO-paired launches burn wstO, increasing the O backing each remaining share. Each chain has its own independent vault and exchange rate
methodology: Counts the O tokens held by each chain's wstO vault as staking.
